Liftally Privacy Policy

Effective Date: January 2026

Liftally respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information.

Information We Collect

Liftally allows users to record and manage workout-related data, including:

  • exercise names
  • workout logs
  • weights
  • repetitions
  • RPE and training metrics
  • optional profile information
  • leaderboard submissions
  • optional heart rate or workout-related health data if permission is granted through Apple HealthKit

Some data may be stored locally on your device. If cloud sync, leaderboard, or AI-powered features are used, related data may be securely transmitted and stored using industry-standard encryption.

How We Use Information

We use collected information only to:

  • provide workout tracking functionality
  • sync workout data across devices
  • generate AI-powered training recommendations
  • operate leaderboard and community features
  • improve app stability and performance

Health Data

If you choose to grant Apple HealthKit permissions, Liftally may access workout or heart rate related data to support fitness and training features.

Health data is used solely for workout and fitness-related functionality and is not sold to advertisers or used for advertising purposes.

Third-Party Services

Liftally may use trusted third-party services, including:

  • Apple services
  • Firebase services
  • cloud-based AI providers

These services may process limited data necessary to provide app functionality and use secure encryption protocols.

Data Security

Liftally uses industry-standard encryption and security measures provided by Apple platforms and trusted service providers to help protect your information.

Subscriptions and Purchases

Liftally may offer optional in-app subscriptions through Apple's App Store. Payment processing and subscription management are handled by Apple.

Contact

If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact:
